note: ORGANIZATION CONFIGURATION → ALERT EMAIL DRAFTS (owner, 8 Oct). Every email the product can send by itself: when it goes, who gets it, and the draft text with {placeholders}. These are the SHIPPED defaults; the screen saves the tenant's own version over them (versioned customisation `alert-emails`), and the mail server settings separately (`alert-emails-smtp`). Nothing is sent until a mail server is saved and 'Send emails' is switched on.

placeholders.emi_detail: Instalment n of N, outstanding after it (EMI alerts)

documents.label: People → Documents (every document with an expiry)

certificate_expiry.label: Certificate expiry alert
certificate_expiry.trigger_note: Sent when a certificate's expiry is this many days away (each milestone once; if the app was not opened that day it goes out on the next run).
certificate_expiry.subject: Action needed: your {certificate} expires on {expiry_date} ({days_left} days left)

absent_yesterday.label: Previous-day absence alert
absent_yesterday.trigger_note: Sent the morning after a working day on which the employee had no punch, no approved leave, no holiday and no weekly off — the same ABSENT the Attendance Report and payroll show. Ships off: switch it on only once the biometric punches arrive before the send time, or people who worked are told they were absent.
absent_yesterday.subject: Marked absent on {absent_date} — please regularise if this is wrong

probation_ending.label: Probation ending reminder
probation_ending.trigger_note: Sent when an employee's probation end date is this many days away.
probation_ending.subject: Probation of {emp_name} ({emp_code}) ends on {probation_end}
probation_ending.body:
Hello,

The probation of {emp_name} ({emp_code}, {designation}, {branch}) ends on {probation_end} — {days_left} day(s) from today.

Please review and confirm or extend the probation on SmartPRS (Probation board).

Regards,
HR — {company}

probation_completed.label: Probation completion
probation_completed.trigger_note: Sent on the day an employee's probation period completes (0 = the end date itself; add 1 or 3 for an advance notice). The end date is the employee's company probation (Organization Configuration → Companies) or an extension.
probation_completed.subject: Probation period of {emp_name} ({emp_code}) completes on {probation_end}
probation_completed.body:
Hello,

The probation period of {emp_name} ({emp_code}, {designation}, {branch}) completes on {probation_end}.

Reporting manager: please share your feedback. HR: please confirm or extend the probation on SmartPRS (People → Probation). Statutory deductions that do not apply during probation start from the month of confirmation.

Regards,
HR — {company}

emi_deduction.label: Loan / salary advance EMI deduction
emi_deduction.trigger_note: Sent this many days before the end of each month to every employee with a loan or salary advance instalment that this month's payroll will deduct — one email per loan / advance, with the instalment and what remains after it (the same figures the payslip will carry).
emi_deduction.subject: {emi_label}: {emi_amount} will be deducted from your {emi_month} salary
emi_deduction.body:
Dear {emp_name},

This is to let you know that {emi_amount} towards your {emi_label} will be deducted from your salary for {emi_month}.

Details: {emi_detail}.

Employee ID: {emp_code}

For any question, please contact HR.

Regards,
HR — {company}

birthday.label: Birthday wishes
birthday.subject: Happy Birthday, {emp_name}!
birthday.body:
Dear {emp_name},

Wishing you a very happy birthday and a wonderful year ahead!

Warm regards,
Team {company}

work_anniversary.label: Work anniversary wishes
work_anniversary.trigger_note: Sent on the anniversary of the date of joining (from one year).
work_anniversary.subject: Congratulations on {years} year(s) with {company}, {emp_name}!
work_anniversary.body:
Dear {emp_name},

Congratulations on completing {years} year(s) with {company} today. Thank you for your contribution.

Warm regards,
Team {company}

appraisal_letter.label: Appraisal letter
appraisal_letter.trigger_note: Sent for each appraisal applied (Performance Appraisal → Apply, or the rating import on Increment / Appraisal).
appraisal_letter.subject: Your appraisal for {review_period} — revised CTC effective {effective_date}

promotion_letter.label: Promotion letter
promotion_letter.trigger_note: Sent for each Effected row on Increment / Appraisal that carries a New Designation.
promotion_letter.subject: Congratulations on your promotion to {new_designation}
promotion_letter.body:
Dear {emp_name},

We are delighted to inform you that you have been promoted from {designation} to {new_designation}, effective {effective_date}. Your revised annual CTC is {new_ctc}.

Congratulations and best wishes in your new role.

Regards,
HR — {company}

increment_letter.label: Increment letter
increment_letter.trigger_note: Sent for each Effected increment that is neither an appraisal nor a promotion.
increment_letter.subject: Revision of your CTC effective {effective_date}
increment_letter.body:
Dear {emp_name},

Your annual CTC has been revised from {old_ctc} to {new_ctc} ({increment_pct}%), effective {effective_date}.

Regards,
HR — {company}

confirmation_letter.label: Confirmation letter
confirmation_letter.trigger_note: Sent when an employee is confirmed on the Probation board.
confirmation_letter.subject: Confirmation of your employment
confirmation_letter.body:
Dear {emp_name},

We are pleased to confirm your employment as {designation} with {company} with effect from {confirmation_date}.

Congratulations!

Regards,
HR — {company}

when_options.on_record: As soon as it is recorded
